Hi, Derek, it’s former Congresswoman Elaine Luria. I just won my primary to become the official Democratic nominee for Virginia’s 2nd District.

Before we take this fight to November, I want to share a little bit about my story and my values, and explain why I’m running for Congress.

I grew up in Birmingham, Alabama, and joined the Navy when I was just 17 years old.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136935224/639081423/-2112690191?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_LuriaSplit_250809_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDA3N2UwZi00Njk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V8cf2DzGOI6HwXx2wmrmHYszTf0iw_SaJEqz2Jlwzrc=)
My lifelong knack for STEM subjects led me to become one of the first female nuclear engineers in Navy history. While deployed to the Middle East, I oversaw eight nuclear reactors and was responsible for training all 700 nuclear operators onboard our aircraft carrier.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136935225/639081424/-2112690191?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_LuriaSplit_250809_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDA3N2UwZi00Njk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V8cf2DzGOI6HwXx2wmrmHYszTf0iw_SaJEqz2Jlwzrc=)
I spent the next 20 years serving on combatant ships defending American security, from the Indian Ocean to the Sea of Japan to the Arabian Gulf.

When I retired from the Navy in 2017, I was ready to focus on being a mom and keeping my small business, the Mermaid Factory, successful.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136935226/639081425/-2112690191?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_LuriaSplit_250809_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDA3N2UwZi00Njk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V8cf2DzGOI6HwXx2wmrmHYszTf0iw_SaJEqz2Jlwzrc=)
Still, I couldn’t shake the desire to do more for my community and my country. I couldn't sit idly by while politicians fanned the flames of division, hate, and contempt for our fellow Americans.

So, in 2018, I ran for Congress. The odds were stacked against me, but thanks to my grassroots team, I won a narrow victory on Election Day. We did it again in 2020. **I was even ranked one of the most effective freshmen members of the House!**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136935227/639081426/-2112690191?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_LuriaSplit_250809_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDA3N2UwZi00Njk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V8cf2DzGOI6HwXx2wmrmHYszTf0iw_SaJEqz2Jlwzrc=)
Three days after I was sworn in to my second term in Congress, our Capitol was violently attacked. That’s when everything changed.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136935228/639081427/-2112690191?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_LuriaSplit_250809_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDA3N2UwZi00Njk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V8cf2DzGOI6HwXx2wmrmHYszTf0iw_SaJEqz2Jlwzrc=)
I stepped up to serve on the January 6th Committee and seek the truth for the American people.

Sure, I was in one of the most competitive House districts in the country, but the optics didn’t matter: **it was a choice of patriotism over politics.**

In response, Republican super PACs poured millions into this district to take me out. Now that I'm back on the ballot, they're prepared to spend even more to keep it that way.

I’ve dedicated my life to public service since I was 17 years old, and last week, the voters of Virginia’s 2nd District gave me the chance to serve again. I have no plans of stopping now; not at this crossroads for our country.

**This will be one of the most competitive and expensive elections in the country. We can't let special interest groups and pro-Trump super PACs decide the outcome.**

I go by some other names, too: _My grandkids call me “Mimi.”
My four sons call me “Mom.”
My wife Cheryl calls me the love of her life.
Minnesota’s 2nd district calls me “Congresswoman.”
And if you help me get across the finish line this November, Minnesotans will call me “Senator.”_ **I’d be the first lesbian woman to represent Minnesota — but hopefully not the last. I want to share my story with you, and then,[can you please rush a donation to my historic campaign for U.S. Senate, in the FINAL 2 days before my primary election?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136935746/639083047/-1908850949?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.08.09_First-Not-The-Last_B3_F1_S1_C1_90AC_RS-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWYwODAyZC00Nzk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YI2GH69-f2MR8bd5QTCsc7EFR2LrVxm-vVwZph9EJnM=)** | | [ DONATE NOW >> ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136935747/639083048/-1908850949?amount=5&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.08.09_First-Not-The-Last_B3_F1_S1_C1_90AC_RS-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWYwODAyZC00Nzk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YI2GH69-f2MR8bd5QTCsc7EFR2LrVxm-vVwZph9EJnM=)

Growing up in a small rural town, I didn’t see many people like me. I didn’t even come out to my loved ones until college — it felt too risky to be openly gay back then.
_But I knew I wanted to be a mom._ When my son Josh was little, I went through a years-long legal battle — with a judge claiming that having two moms wasn’t in the “best interests” of my child. Every night, I put my son to bed, not sure if he would be ripped away from me the next day.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136935748/639083049/-1908850949?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.08.09_First-Not-The-Last_B3_F1_S1_C1_90AC_RS-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWYwODAyZC00Nzk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YI2GH69-f2MR8bd5QTCsc7EFR2LrVxm-vVwZph9EJnM=)
That was the hardest fight of my life. Thankfully, we won, and our amazing son Josh could stay. Our victory helped pave the way for other LGBTQ+ families to be recognized under the law, too.
Years later, I met my wife Cheryl when she was coaching our kids’ basketball team. In 2008, we tied the knot — our kids proudly giving us away. It was one of the best days of my life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136935749/639083050/-1908850949?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.08.09_First-Not-The-Last_B3_F1_S1_C1_90AC_RS-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWYwODAyZC00Nzk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YI2GH69-f2MR8bd5QTCsc7EFR2LrVxm-vVwZph9EJnM=)
Just weeks after, Proposition 8 passed, and suddenly our marriage was at risk of being erased.
But people spoke up. Neighbors had hard conversations. Communities pushed for change. And together, we built a country that recognizes that love is love.
All these years later, I still carry that same determination with me as I run for U.S. Senate. It’s how I flipped Minnesota’s 2nd district in 2018 and won four consecutive elections against Republicans. It’s how I took on Big Pharma — who spent millions trying to defeat me — and won.
**And it’s how we’re going to win this race for U.S. Senate come November — to defeat Trump’s top pick Michele Tafoya and the harmful agenda she wants to bring to Minnesota’s doorstep.** She wants to sow hate and division, but together, we can stop her.

clean_body: | = = Hey folks, this is Angie Craig. I go by some other names, too: My grandkids call me “Mimi.” My four sons call me “Mom.” My wife Cheryl calls me the love of her life. Minnesota’s 2nd district calls me “Congresswoman.” And if you help me get across the finish line this November, Minnesotans will call me “Senator.” I’d be the first lesbian woman to represent Minnesota — but hopefully not the last. I want to share my story with you, and then,= | | = Growing up in a small rural town, I didn’t see many people like me. I didn’t even come out to my loved ones until college — it felt too risky to be openly gay back then. But I knew I wanted to be a mom. When my son Josh was little, I went through a years-long legal battle — with a judge claiming that having two moms wasn’t in the “best interests” of my child. Every night, I put my son to bed, not sure if he would be ripped away from me the next day. = That was the hardest fight of my life. Thankfully, we won, and our amazing son Josh could stay. Our victory helped pave the way for other LGBTQ+ families to be recognized under the law, too. Years later, I met my wife Cheryl when she was coaching our kids’ basketball team. In 2008, we tied the knot — our kids proudly giving us away. It was one of the best days of my life. = Just weeks after, Proposition 8 passed, and suddenly our marriage was at risk of being erased. But people spoke up. Neighbors had hard conversations. Communities pushed for change. And together, we built a country that recognizes that love is love. All these years later, I still carry that same determination with me as I run for U.S. Senate. It’s how I flipped Minnesota’s 2nd district in 2018 and won four consecutive elections against Republicans. It’s how I took on Big Pharma — who spent millions trying to defeat me — and won. And it’s how we’re going to win this race for U.S. Senate come November — to defeat Trump’s top pick Michele Tafoya and the harmful agenda she wants to bring to Minnesota’s doorstep. Abbott was bragging about data centers a few months ago, Peter.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)

He won't do that because he’s too weak and corrupt to stand up to his billionaire donors.

name: Sherrod
subject: $28 million against us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
This is about to get bad.
Friend — I need to level with you.
One Nation, a Republican dark money group, announced that they’re reserving $28 million in ads to target our campaign. My opponent is on the air already. **But here’s the thing -- most of that avalanche of money hasn’t even made it to the airwaves yet.**
This is just the beginning, and we’re about to be pummeled by millions more.
**We need to build up our own reserves so that we can respond when the bulk of their money lands.**
**[Will you split $5 today between my campaign and Chris Pappas to help us match what’s coming?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260809_3.lIfr3g&refcode=em20260809-3&t=1&akid=8217%2E582294%2E4eyFj3)**

Republicans wouldn’t be spending like this if they weren’t scared. They see the same headlines we do: this race is a dead heat. So instead of letting Ohio voters decide on merits, they’re flooding the airwaves and drowning out our message.
We don’t support outside dark money groups covering our costs. But that means we rely on grassroots supporters like you, chipping in when it matters most.
**[Please, split $5 or more between my campaign and Chris Pappas — every hour we wait is airtime they gain.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260809_3.lIfr3g&refcode=em20260809-3&t=21&akid=8217%2E582294%2E4eyFj3)**

granted.

But here’s the truth: In a place like Pennsylvania, a few quiet days can
cost us. If we pull back now, the far-right gets more time to reach voters
first, distort my record, and make their case before we’ve had the chance
to respond.

that’s not a risk we can afford to take,
